keyFormat.passive: game|mode|street|line(check|check_back|call|check_after_call_prev)|band(call: bet faced; na)|players|vs(bettor of the called bet)|actor
keyFormat.preflop: game|mode|position|lvl(0 unopened,1 facing open,2 facing 3bet,3 facing 4bet+)|actor

definitions.band: bet: amount/pot-before; raise: (added - toCall)/(pot + toCall). small <=0.40, half (0.40,0.60], twothirds (0.60,0.80], pot >0.80, allin = all-in
definitions.line: first bet of street by previous-street last aggressor = cbet (flop) / barrel (turn, river); previous street had no aggressor = stab; previous aggressor already checked this street = probe; previous aggressor still to act = donk; raise of a bet = raise, or check_raise if raiser checked earlier this street; jam = any all-in bet/raise (also counted under its structural line)
definitions.opp: horse_present = at least one Horse among live opponents of the bettor; persons_only otherwise
definitions.players: live (unfolded) players incl. bettor at the bet: 2 = hu, else mw

privacy: Public action frequencies only (responses to wagers, preflop actions, VPIP/PFR; per-user rows keyed by user id, no names). Derived from lane RANGES measured-ranges-v1 (source sha256 54ab0460...) by lane MATHCORE: every section built from hidden or non-shown hole cards (ranges, passive, preflopStrength, realization) removed under the lead ruling of 2026-11-19 (live inputs are public information only).
